Sandbox_PhunServer2Wiper_EnableWipe_tool: Off by default, because wiping a map cannot be undone. Tick this to allow map wipes at all. Even then, a player is never wiped the first time this mod sees them; their current wipe key is recorded as a baseline instead.
Sandbox_PhunServer2Wiper_WipeKey_tooltip: Changing this value wipes each player's map once, on their next login. A season or version number works well. Setting it for the first time does NOT wipe anyone: it becomes the baseline, and the next change is what wipes. Use /wipemap if you want a wipe right now.
Sandbox_PhunServer2Wiper_WipeMap_tooltip: Untick if you only want to clear symbols and annotations, leaving the explored map intact
Sandbox_PhunServer2Wiper_WipeSymbols_too: Untick if you only want to clear the explored map, leaving symbols and annotations intact
Sandbox_PhunServer2Wiper_WipePerCharacte: Wipe a player's map whenever their character dies and they start a new one. Hardcore.
